node.statement: For completeness, matrix multiplication with the displayed parenthesizations gives (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X = sum_j (sum_i Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j = sum_{i,j}(Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j and Y^dagger dot (Z dot X) = sum_i Y_i^dagger dot (sum_j Z_ij dot X_j) = sum_{i,j}Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j), using only bilinearity of dot to distribute finite sums (not associativity). Together with node 1.2.3.2, substitution into the finite-sum equality of node 1.2.2 yields exactly node 1.2. The compression external is used only for the stated amplified corner typing and dagger compatibility.
